name: Smart IP - Language Negotiation Redirect
description: Redirects users to a language/site version based on their IP-geolocated country.
project_description:
This module adds language redirection via Smart IP module.

 Usage: 
 Recommend to use along with Language Cookie module. This way you prevent IP to Language resolution for every page request.

 
 Enable the module and go to: Administration \ Configuration \ Regional and language \ Languages 
 Enable the " Smart IP country code " detection method and re-arrange the detection methods as you see fit. The recommended arrangement is: " URL \ Cookie \ Smart IP country code ". 
 Edit the configuration of the module, by adding the country code mapping to each corresponding language. 
 
 Dependencies: 
 
 Smart IP 
 
 Best used with: 
 
 Language Cookie
